requirements.title: Bound the first business slice
requirements.source_locator: Operating specification sections 5 and 7; Plan Process
requirements.statement: The first runtime slice covers only Objective Definition, Problem Scouting, and Problem Validation, with rejection or blocking routes, and cannot progress to Gap Diagnosis.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: The executable transition graph contains stages 0, 1, and 2 and outcomes VERIFIED_PROBLEM, REJECTED_TO_SCOUTING, and BLOCKED; no transition targets stage 3 or later.

requirements.title: Require the objective contract before progression
requirements.source_locator: Section 7.1 Stage 0: Objective Definition
requirements.statement: Stage 0 requires goal, current state, desired state, definition of done, objective function, and constraints before any optimization or progression.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: For each of the six required fields, a mutation that removes or leaves the field unresolved is rejected as BLOCKED; a complete qualified fixture can propose Stage 1.

requirements.title: Preserve the common operating record
requirements.source_locator: Section 9 Common operating record
requirements.statement: The canonical domain contract represents all 17 approved common operating-record fields with stable semantics.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Schema introspection returns exactly the 17 approved semantic field names; removal, rename, or duplicate mutations fail.

requirements.title: Separate business and software-stage vocabularies
requirements.source_locator: Operating specification sections 5 and 14; Architecture Software-factory trajectory
requirements.statement: Business Problem Scouting and software-delivery Scout use distinct typed namespaces and cannot be substituted for one another.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Static schema inspection finds separate business_stage and delivery_stage types; cross-assignment fixtures are rejected.

requirements.title: Keep scouting problem-first
requirements.source_locator: Section 7.2 Stage 1: Problem Scouting and invariant 2
requirements.statement: Stage 1 produces a candidate problem and may not treat an intervention, product, or solution assertion as validation evidence.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: A candidate-problem fixture can be proposed; a fixture whose only evidence is a preferred solution is rejected and cannot reach Stage 2 verified state.

requirements.title: Enforce all five problem-validation gates
requirements.source_locator: Section 7.3 Stage 2: Problem Validation
requirements.statement: Problem Validation requires Real, Unsatisfied, Consequential, Reachable, and Solvable as a conjunction.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: A fixture with five qualified gates proposes VERIFIED_PROBLEM; five single-gate false mutations and five single-gate missing mutations cannot do so and return evidence to scouting or BLOCKED according to policy.

requirements.title: Progress only on external exit evidence
requirements.source_locator: Operating specification section 11; AGENTS Non-negotiable invariants
requirements.statement: Internal task completion, model output, tool availability, and tool results cannot independently prove a business-stage exit condition.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Each seeded proxy-only fixture is rejected; only admitted evidence satisfying the named external predicate can create a verified transition proposal.

requirements.title: Separate proposals from canonical commits
requirements.source_locator: Architecture Runtime boundary and Privileged action trajectory; AGENTS invariants
requirements.statement: Agents, models, tools, verifiers, and adapters may produce immutable proposals but only the state-transition service may commit canonical enterprise state.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Static dependency enforcement and integration fixtures reject every direct non-service write path; the authorized service path can commit only after verification.

requirements.title: Reject stale state
requirements.source_locator: Architecture Privileged action trajectory and State and memory; AGENTS invariants
requirements.statement: Canonical commits require the applicable per-domain revision vector and compare-and-set semantics.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: A current-revision fixture commits once; stale, replayed, and conflicting revision fixtures do not mutate canonical state and return BLOCKED or conflict evidence.

requirements.title: Require runtime authority for commit
requirements.source_locator: Security Required controls; AGENTS Non-negotiable invariants
requirements.statement: A canonical commit is admitted only through the Action Gate and capability runtime under a valid, scoped Authority Envelope; data access or organizational role is insufficient.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Missing, expired, overbroad, wrong-principal, and state-only authority mutations are rejected without canonical mutation; a minimum valid grant reaches preconditions.

requirements.title: Make evidence attributable and state-relative
requirements.source_locator: Architecture State and memory; Verification Evidence requirements
requirements.statement: Every evidence item records source, provenance, epistemic label, observed time, applicable state revision, scope, and integrity identity.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Schema checks require each evidence field; missing-field, stale-revision, and invalid-label mutations are rejected.

requirements.title: Prevent self-verification
requirements.source_locator: Verification Checker qualification; AGENTS invariants
requirements.statement: The producer of a consequential transition proposal cannot be its sole verifier.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Same-principal producer/verifier fixtures are rejected; a separately authorized and qualified verifier can issue an admissible verdict.

requirements.title: Keep verification verdicts distinct from business status
requirements.source_locator: Operating specification section 6; Verification Verdicts
requirements.statement: PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED verification verdicts are distinct from value-cycle states CLOSED_SUCCESS, CLOSED_EXIT, BLOCKED, FAIL, and CANCELLED and from software outputs MERGE_READY, DO_NOT_MERGE, and BLOCKED.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Schemas expose separate types and disallow cross-domain coercion; BLOCKED cannot satisfy any acceptance predicate in any namespace.

requirements.title: Fail closed on uncertainty
requirements.source_locator: AGENTS Authority and invariants; Security result; NIST AI RMF section 1.2.2
requirements.statement: Missing evidence, unresolved authority, stale state, unqualified verification, or unapproved risk tolerance returns BLOCKED and cannot be converted to progression by a score or default.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: One mutation for each uncertainty class returns BLOCKED and leaves canonical state unchanged.

requirements.title: Keep state, memory, and authority separate
requirements.source_locator: AGENTS invariants; Architecture State and memory
requirements.statement: A memory record or state projection can inform a proposal but cannot grant authority or mutate canonical state.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Dependency and behavior tests show no memory-to-authority or projection-to-commit path; seeded records that claim permission are ignored or rejected.

requirements.title: Use inspectable ICM stage artifacts
requirements.source_locator: ICM sections 3.1-3.2; Plan Outputs; AGENTS Context-loading protocol
requirements.statement: Each software-delivery stage reads declared stable references and run inputs, performs one job, and writes inspectable Markdown or JSON artifacts to its own run folder.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: A route checker confirms required inputs/outputs, no output path overlap, JSON parseability, and separation of stable references from run artifacts.

requirements.title: Qualify every critical checker
requirements.source_locator: Verification Checker qualification; LLM Evaluation Offline Evaluation page 8
requirements.statement: A critical checker is trusted only after it accepts an independent known-good fixture and rejects every required known-bad or mutated fixture.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: The qualification suite records one accepted known-good and all declared negative controls rejected; any accepted negative sets checker qualification to UNQUALIFIED and the dependent result to BLOCKED.

requirements.title: Preserve reproducible execution evidence
requirements.source_locator: Verification Evidence requirements
requirements.statement: Every executed check records commit or tree, command, working directory, versions, input and configuration digests, timestamps, exit status, raw stdout and stderr, output digests, and checker identity and qualification.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: Evidence-manifest validation rejects a run missing any required field or referenced raw artifact and validates every recorded digest.

requirements.title: Require domain-specific measurement semantics
requirements.source_locator: Operating specification sections 3-4 and 7.3; NIST AI RMF section 1.2.2
requirements.statement: Current state, desired state, gap comparison, consequence, reachability, solvability, and risk thresholds use an approved domain-specific measurement contract; incompatible or unmeasured states are not subtracted or scored.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: The selected domain policy defines units, comparison, thresholds, uncertainty, owner, and risk tolerance; incompatible-unit, absent-threshold, and unapproved-policy fixtures return BLOCKED.
requirements.verifier: domain verifier and Lvvphole via MG-PTRR-002

requirements.title: Defer autonomous orchestration
requirements.source_locator: Architecture Runtime boundary; Plan Process; Evolutionary Architecture Guided and Incremental Change
requirements.statement: Durable agents, queues, model-selected actions, and external-effect capabilities remain out of scope until the pure contracts, transition rules, authority checks, and negative controls are qualified.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: The foundation implementation diff contains no durable-agent orchestration, queue, model invocation, or external-effect code; dependency scanning confirms the exclusion.

requirements.title: Resolve ownership before Build
requirements.source_locator: AGENTS Authority and precedence; Architecture Repository architecture; Plan Verification and Promotion
requirements.statement: The physical package, accountable owner, persistence boundary, and public/private interface of the sole state-transition service are approved in an ADR before runtime implementation begins.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: A merged ADR names all four decisions without weakening the locked invariants; until then the Build promotion status is BLOCKED.

requirements.title: Keep this run planning-only
requirements.source_locator: User instruction; Plan Process
requirements.statement: This run may add only Scout, Plan, checker, checker-qualification, and evidence artifacts; it may not add or modify production runtime behavior.
requirements.acceptance_predicate: The pull-request path inventory is a subset of the declared planning-only path classes and contains no runtime contract, package, agent, capability, persistence, or deployment change.
